name: chain-of-custody
description: Make Claude Code work like a small software team: it plans your app, designs each feature, writes the code, reviews its own work, and shows you each piece running.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branches that are shared: no edits to app source while checked out, no push. main and master are always protected. /init writes this into .claude/loop.config.md.

integration_branch.title: Integration branch
integration_branch.description: The loop's integration branch, if you use one. Protected like main. Empty means none.

main_edit_allow.title: Extra editable paths on main
main_edit_allow.description: Comma-separated path globs that may be edited while on a protected branch. Empty means only the built-in set.
